# Envelope slot role

<!-- Generated by `loom modules --markdown` from the role descriptor. -->

Makes a level that rises when a gate goes high and falls when it goes low.

ID `loom.role.envelope` · Version 1

## Inputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gate (`gate`) | gate | Required | Going high starts the envelope; going low releases it. |

## Outputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Out (`out`) | modulation | Required | The envelope level, from 0 to 1. |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Unit | Values | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attack (`attack`) | s | Continuous | Required | Time to rise after the gate goes high. |
| Release (`release`) | s | Continuous | Required | Time to fall after the gate goes low. |
| Decay (`decay`) | s | Continuous | Optional | Time to fall to the sustain level after the attack. |
| Sustain (`sustain`) |  | Continuous | Optional | The level held while the gate stays high. |

## Modules that fill this role

- [Envelope](loom.env.envelope.md)
